question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.**

Satisfactory
solution:
The correct answer is "Inadequate."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The word "Satisfactory" means good enough for a particular purpose; acceptable. (संतोषजनक (उद्देश्‍य विशेष के लिए पर्याप्त); स्‍वीकार्य)

 
 
• Example: *This piece of work is not **satisfactory**__. Please do it again.*
 
 
 
• The antonym of **"Satisfactory"** is** "Inadequate."**
 
• The word "Inadequate" means not enough; not good enough. (अपर्याप्त, नाकाफ़ी; अयोग्‍य)
 __
 
• Example:* I feel **inadequate**__ when I talk to Miranda about art because she knows so much.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is option 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Diminish: **to become or to make something smaller or less important; decrease. (छोटा होना या छोटा करना, महत्व घटाना; कम होना या करना)
 
• **Morose: **bad-tempered, and not saying much to other people. (बदमिज़ाज, असौम्‍य (और अपने तक सीमित))
 
• **Revive: **to become or to make somebody/something strong or healthy again; to come or to bring somebody back to life or consciousness. (किसी का पुनरुज्‍जीवित होना या करना; किसी का पुनः जीवित होना या करना)
